maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is from renting and selling composite DURA-BASE matting for new project site access, plus services, not repairing existing installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private utilities, pipeline and energy companies renting mats for projects; not mainly government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through matting rentals and sales; the Northeast acquisitions (WGS, UAS, Lentzcaping) are occasional, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Temporary matting rentals for project access; customers can switch to other mat suppliers fairly easily, with no deep integration.

notes: Includes a smaller environmental services business, which was not weighed heavily; mat rental and sales is the larger part.
